pictures.name: QIB1-Lights-Bowing
pictures.prompt: A great field of golden wheat at dawn under a vast deep-blue and gold sky, every stalk bending low together in one long wave of wind, like a single bow. Reverent and immense. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
